items.question: What was the total value of completed orders last month?
items.author: team

B0.sql:
SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_completed_last_month
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
  AND substr(order_date, 1, 7) = strftime('%Y-%m', 'now', '-1 month');

B1.sql:
WITH max_order_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_date FROM orders
),
month_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m-01', max_date, '-1 month') AS start_date,
    strftime('%Y-%m-01', max_date) AS end_date
  FROM max_order_date
)
SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_value
FROM orders o
JOIN month_bounds mb
  ON o.order_date >= mb.start_date
 AND o.order_date < mb.end_date
WHERE o.status = 'completed';

B2.sql:
SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_completed_last_month
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
  AND substr(order_date, 1, 7) = strftime('%Y-%m', 'now', '-1 month');

B3.sql:
WITH max_order_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_date FROM orders
),
month_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m-01', max_date, '-1 month') AS start_date,
    strftime('%Y-%m-01', max_date) AS end_date
  FROM max_order_date
)
SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_value
FROM orders o
JOIN month_bounds mb
  ON o.order_date >= mb.start_date

items.question: Berapa jumlah nilai pesanan yang selesai pada bulan lepas?
items.author: team

B0.sql:
-- Total value of completed orders from the month preceding the latest order in the database
WITH max_order_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_dt FROM orders
),
last_month AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', max_dt, '-1 month') AS lm FROM max_order_date
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_completed_last_month
FROM orders o
JOIN last_month ON strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = last_month.lm
WHERE o.status = 'completed';
